name: CROSSOVER
source:
This game is "Visual Novels".
Kazune like to sing .
Story of he with people he encounters , dreams and love and jealousy .
Kazune loves boys and girls.
[Source: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/crossover-yaoi/id1122590485]
translation:
這是一款「視覺小說」。
和音喜歡唱歌。
這是關於他與邂逅的人們、夢想、愛情和嫉妒的故事。
和音喜歡男孩，也喜歡女孩。
［來源：https://apps.apple.com/us/app/crossover-yaoi/id1122590485］
